title: Why Teachers Aren’t Ready to Reopen Schools

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的DealBook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at NYTimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在NYTimes.com上免费直播部分精选采访，供所有人观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: So far, the debate over school reopenings has been dominated by a president who is determined to send students back into classrooMs.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，关于学校重开的辩论一直由一位决心让学生重返课堂的总统所主导。

sentences.en: We want to reopen the schools.
sentences.zh: 我们想要重开学校。

sentences.en: Everybody wants it.
sentences.zh: 每个人都想重开。

sentences.en: The moms want it.
sentences.zh: 妈妈们想重开。

sentences.en: The dads want it.
sentences.zh: 爸爸们想重开。

sentences.en: The kids want it.
sentences.zh: 孩子们想重开。

sentences.en: It's time to do it.
sentences.zh: 是时候这么做了。

sentences.en: And by local school officials who are answering that call.
sentences.zh: 还有那些响应这一号召的地方学校官员。

sentences.en: So we're very much going to put pressure on governors and everybody else to open the schools.
sentences.zh: 所以我们非常希望能向州长和其他所有人施压，要求他们开放学校。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Dana Goldstein on why teachers and their unions are defying those plans.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事达娜·戈尔茨坦将讲述为什么教师及其工会要抵制这些计划。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, August 13th.
sentences.zh: 今天是8月13日，星期四。

sentences.en: Good evening.
sentences.zh: 晚上好。

sentences.en: I stand here tonight not only as governor of Florida, but as a husband, a father, a son, and a friend.
sentences.zh: 今晚我站在这里，不仅是以佛罗里达州州长的身份，更是以丈夫、父亲、儿子和朋友的身份。

sentences.en: To have a conversation about how we as Floridians approach these challenging times.
sentences.zh: 来探讨我们佛罗里达人该如何应对这些充满挑战的时期。

sentences.en: Now, as a parent of three, I know that my fellow parents here in Florida want nothing more than to provide a bright future for their children.
sentences.zh: 作为三个孩子的家长，我知道佛罗里达州的家长们最希望的就是为他们的孩子提供一个光明的未来。

sentences.en: And here's the hard truth.
sentences.zh: 但这里有一个残酷的事实。

sentences.en: While the risks to students from in-person learning are low, the cost of keeping schools closed are enormous.
sentences.zh: 虽然面对面授课对学生造成的风险很低，但让学校持续关闭的代价却是巨大的。

sentences.en: Dana, tell me about this situation with schools in Florida.
sentences.zh: 达娜，跟我说说佛罗里达州学校的情况。

sentences.en: In early July, just as the Trump administration from Washington was pushing schools to reopen their physical campuses across the country,
sentences.zh: 7月初，就在华盛顿的特朗普政府推动全国各地的学校重开实体校园时，

sentences.en: Florida was a state that really leaned heavily in that same direction under their Republican governor, Ron DeSantis.
sentences.zh: 佛罗里达州在共和党州长罗恩·德桑蒂斯的领导下，也确实在朝着同一个方向大力推进。

sentences.en: The important thing is that our parents have a meaningful choice when it comes to in-person education.
sentences.zh: 重要的是，我们的家长在面对面教育方面拥有有意义的选择权。

sentences.en: Let's not let fear get the best of us and harm our children in the process.
sentences.zh: 不要让恐惧占据上风，从而在这个过程中伤害我们的孩子。

sentences.en: The state issued this executive order.
sentences.zh: 州政府发布了这项行政命令。

sentences.en: The state is announcing it's requiring all schools to reopen for in-person classes next month, AuguSt.
sentences.zh: 州政府宣布要求所有学校在下个月，即8月，重开进行面对面授课。

sentences.en: Telling schools that they had to reopen five days a week.
sentences.zh: 告知学校必须每周开放五天。

sentences.en: So that announcement coming today, given where Florida is, your analysis.
sentences.zh: 那么，考虑到佛罗里达州目前的状况，你对今天发布的这一公告有何分析？

sentences.en: I mean, my analysis is that that is insane.
sentences.zh: 我的分析是，这简直是疯了。

sentences.en: And this was shocking to superintendents and school boards.
sentences.zh: 这对学区主管和校董会来说是令人震惊的。

sentences.en: You know, they had spent the months of May, June, into July mostly planning for a hybrid model of education.
sentences.zh: 要知道，他们花了5月、6月甚至7月的大部分时间来规划混合教育模式。

sentences.en: Kids would go to school two or three or maybe even just one day a week in person and be home learning online the rest of the time.
sentences.zh: 孩子们每周去学校上课两三天，甚至可能只有一天，其余时间在家在线学习。

sentences.en: School districts all of a sudden were being told you have to offer parents and families the option of five days a week in the building.
sentences.zh: 学区突然被告知，必须为家长和家庭提供每周五天在校上课的选择。

sentences.en: So we are not ready to open schools in four weeks.
sentences.zh: 所以我们还没有准备好在四周内开放学校。

sentences.en: We need to slow down and take a pause and get this right around the state firSt.
sentences.zh: 我们需要放慢脚步，暂停一下，先在全州范围内把这件事做好。

sentences.en: And what would happen if schools didn't physically reopen five days a week?
sentences.zh: 如果学校没有在实体上每周开放五天，会发生什么？

sentences.en: You know, I think the kind of underlying threat was that you would lose state dollars if you don't provide families with this option for in-person learning.
sentences.zh: 我认为潜在的威胁是，如果你不为家庭提供这种面对面学习的选择，你就会失去州政府的拨款。

sentences.en: And this threat to them was quite scary because state funding for education is the main funding that funds our school system in the United States.
sentences.zh: 这种威胁对他们来说非常可怕，因为州政府的教育经费是美国学校系统的主要资金来源。

sentences.en: And what was the state of the pandemic when the state of Florida makes this demand?
sentences.zh: 那么，当佛罗里达州提出这一要求时，疫情处于什么状态？

sentences.en: So these numbers were so shocking to us when we did reporting on this that we actually fact-checked them many, many times to make sure they were correct.
sentences.zh: 当我们报道这些数据时，它们令我们感到非常震惊，以至于我们反复核实了很多次，以确保它们是准确的。

sentences.en: Florida shattering its daily record, recording more than 15,000 cases, accounting for a quarter of the total new daily cases in the United States.
sentences.zh: 佛罗里达州打破了每日新增病例记录，记录超过15,000例，占美国每日新增病例总数的四分之一。

sentences.en: In some South Florida counties in the month of July.
sentences.zh: 在7月份，南佛罗里达州的一些县。

sentences.en: South Florida's Miami-Dade has seen a staggering daily positivity rate of 33 percent.
sentences.zh: 南佛罗里达州的迈阿密-戴德县的每日阳性率达到了惊人的33%。

sentences.en: Between 20 and 30 percent of coronavirus tests were coming back positive.
sentences.zh: 20%到30%的新冠病毒检测结果呈阳性。

sentences.en: And the World Health Organization, the state of California, the state of New York,
sentences.zh: 而世界卫生组织、加利福尼亚州、纽约州，

sentences.en: have tended to use a range of about 5 percent to 10 percent test positivity rates as something to look at when deciding whether or not to open schools.
sentences.zh: 在决定是否重开学校时，往往会将5%到10%左右的检测阳性率作为参考指标。

sentences.en: So here you might see, you know, four times that number in a city like Miami.
sentences.zh: 所以在这里，你可能会看到像迈阿密这样的城市，其阳性率是那个指标的四倍。

sentences.en: Here in Miami-Dade, according to county data released yesterday, the goal for the county is not to exceed 10 percent.
sentences.zh: 在迈阿密-戴德县，根据昨天公布的县数据，该县的目标是不超过10%。

sentences.en: They have exceeded that for the past 14 days.
sentences.zh: 他们过去14天已经超过了这个数字。

sentences.en: You know, a strong indication that the virus is completely unchecked in that region.
sentences.zh: 这是一个强烈的信号，表明病毒在该地区完全处于失控状态。

sentences.en: In fact, it was one of the most dangerous cities for the virus in the United States.
sentences.zh: 事实上，它是美国受病毒影响最危险的城市之一。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So what was the reaction across Florida to this executive order?
sentences.zh: 那么佛罗里达州对这项行政命令的反应如何？

sentences.en: Anger.
sentences.zh: 愤怒。

sentences.en: If the governor wants to open schools publicly, how about we invite him to come and teach in the classroom?
sentences.zh: 如果州长想公开重开学校，我们何不邀请他亲自来教室教书呢？

sentences.en: You know, a lot of teachers and educators were angry.
sentences.zh: 很多教师和教育工作者都很愤怒。

sentences.en: If he wants to open schools, how about he provide teachers with hazard pay?
sentences.zh: 如果他想重开学校，他何不为教师提供危险津贴呢？

sentences.en: Because that's exactly what you're doing.
sentences.zh: 因为这正是你们正在做的事情。

sentences.en: You're on the front lines of a pandemic that you didn't start, you didn't call for, and we don't have control.
sentences.zh: 你们身处一场并非由你们发起、并非由你们要求，且我们无法控制的疫情的最前线。

sentences.en: Because they felt that their safety, and in some respects, safety of the entire community from a public health perspective, was nowhere in this conversation.
sentences.zh: 因为他们觉得，从公共卫生的角度来看，他们的安全，在某些方面甚至是整个社区的安全，在这次对话中根本没有被考虑在内。

sentences.en: I teach my students the history of America, how this government has run, how it works.
sentences.zh: 我教我的学生美国历史，政府是如何运作的，它是如何工作的。

sentences.en: This is a democracy.
sentences.zh: 这是一个民主国家。

sentences.en: Our voices need to be heard.
sentences.zh: 我们的声音需要被听到。

sentences.en: And my inbox and social media were filled with messages from teachers.
sentences.zh: 我的收件箱和社交媒体上塞满了教师们发来的信息。

sentences.en: So I want everyone to hear my voice, that if I die from catching COVID-19, from being forced back into Pinellas County Schools, you can drop my dead body right here.
sentences.zh: 所以我希望每个人都能听到我的声音，如果我因为被迫回到皮内拉斯县的学校而感染新冠病毒死亡，你们可以直接把我的尸体扔在这里。

sentences.en: Leave my body right here.
sentences.zh: 把我的尸体留在这里。

sentences.en: And it was just this sense that the question of whether we should go back did not pay enough attention to teachers' health risks.
sentences.zh: 这种感觉就是，关于我们是否应该回去的问题，并没有充分关注教师的健康风险。

sentences.en: Do you feel ready to return to your classroom?
sentences.zh: 你觉得准备好回到教室了吗？

sentences.en: I do not.
sentences.zh: 我没有。

sentences.en: I personally have lost sleep over it.
sentences.zh: 我个人为此失眠。

sentences.en: I've cried over it.
sentences.zh: 我为此哭过。

sentences.en: I cry over it a lot.
sentences.zh: 我为此哭了很多次。

sentences.en: It's very, very scary.
sentences.zh: 这非常、非常可怕。

sentences.en: And the one thing I'm going to say, I will say online learning is not ideal, but it will keep our children safe.
sentences.zh: 我要说的一点是，在线学习并不理想，但它能保证我们孩子的安全。

sentences.en: I'm a teacher.
sentences.zh: 我是一名教师。

sentences.en: I've been with Duval County for 23 years.
sentences.zh: 我在杜瓦尔县工作了23年。

sentences.en: I have a mother at home that is sick.
sentences.zh: 我家里有一位生病的母亲。

sentences.en: And if I am to get the coronavirus, I don't want to bring it back to her.
sentences.zh: 如果我感染了新冠病毒，我不想把它带回家传染给她。

sentences.en: Yes, it's really important that kids get educated.
sentences.zh: 是的，让孩子们接受教育非常重要。

sentences.en: It's really important that parents be able to work during the day and children have the basic child care that schools provide.
sentences.zh: 让家长能够在白天工作，让孩子们获得学校提供的基本托儿服务，这非常重要。

sentences.en: However.
sentences.zh: 然而。

sentences.en: We teachers love our students and we agree that the best place for our students is in school, but that's only if they're safe.
sentences.zh: 我们教师热爱我们的学生，我们也同意学生最好的去处是学校，但前提是他们必须是安全的。

sentences.en: If going to school is more dangerous for our students or for their families, then we should hold off and do some sort of distance learning or hybrid model until it's safe for them.
sentences.zh: 如果去学校对我们的学生或他们的家庭来说更危险，那么我们应该推迟，并采取某种远程学习或混合模式，直到对他们来说是安全的为止。

sentences.en: I think there's no way to social distance in our already crowded classrooMs.
sentences.zh: 我认为在我们本已拥挤的教室里，根本无法保持社交距离。

sentences.en: There is not enough money to provide for the extra staff that we would need and the extra PPE that we would need.
sentences.zh: 没有足够的资金来提供我们所需的额外人员和额外的个人防护装备。

sentences.en: I don't think that it's worth the risk.
sentences.zh: 我不认为这值得冒险。

sentences.en: We are used to going into schools that sometimes don't have soap in the bathrooms, that sometimes have broken windows that prevent us from circulating fresh air,
sentences.zh: 我们习惯了进入那些有时洗手间没有肥皂、有时窗户破损导致无法流通新鲜空气的学校，

sentences.en: that have dated heating and ventilation systeMs.
sentences.zh: 那些供暖和通风系统陈旧的学校。

sentences.en: And where is our health in this equation?
sentences.zh: 在这个等式中，我们的健康在哪里？

sentences.en: This is not how I want to go back.
sentences.zh: 这不是我想要回去的方式。

sentences.en: And I want to go back so bad because I love teaching.
sentences.zh: 我非常想回去，因为我热爱教学。

sentences.en: I miss my classroom.
sentences.zh: 我想念我的教室。

sentences.en: I miss my kids.
sentences.zh: 我想念我的孩子们。

sentences.en: So what did teachers in Florida do?
sentences.zh: 那么佛罗里达州的教师们做了什么？

sentences.en: The largest teachers union in Florida is suing the state over its executive order mandating that schools reopen next month with in-person instruction.
sentences.zh: 佛罗里达州最大的教师工会正在就州政府下个月强制学校重开进行面对面授课的行政命令起诉州政府。

sentences.en: So a bunch of the local and national union groups that represent teachers came together and they sued the state of Florida.
sentences.zh: 所以，代表教师的一群地方和全国工会组织联合起来，起诉了佛罗里达州政府。

sentences.en: In the lawsuit, the union says the state is unconstitutionally forcing millions of students and teachers into unsafe schools.
sentences.zh: 在诉讼中，工会表示州政府违宪地强迫数百万学生和教师进入不安全的学校。

sentences.en: Saying that this executive order requiring schools to reopen five days a week in person actually violated Florida's own state law that also calls for schools to be safe.
sentences.zh: 称这项要求学校每周五天面对面重开的行政命令，实际上违反了佛罗里达州自身要求学校必须安全的法律。

sentences.en: The suit says children are at risk of contracting and spreading the virus and of developing severe illness resulting in death.
sentences.zh: 诉讼称，儿童面临感染和传播病毒以及发展成导致死亡的严重疾病的风险。

sentences.en: And the state mandate to open schools is impossible to comply with CDC guidelines on physical distancing, hygiene and sanitation if schools are operating at full capacity.
sentences.zh: 而且，如果学校满负荷运转，州政府重开学校的指令将无法遵守疾控中心关于保持身体距离、卫生和消毒的指导方针。

sentences.en: It's really very simple what they were arguing that going back five days a week is not safe and therefore it cannot be legal.
sentences.zh: 他们的论点非常简单：每周回去五天是不安全的，因此它不可能是合法的。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: I have to think that it's a pretty unusual act.
sentences.zh: 我不得不认为这是一个非常不寻常的行为。

sentences.en: You know, teachers suing to stop their own schools from reopening.
sentences.zh: 你知道，教师起诉以阻止他们自己的学校重开。

sentences.en: Yes, it's definitely unusual, notable, and interestingly, it paved the way for similar threats to sue across the country, including in northern cities like Chicago and New York.
sentences.zh: 是的，这绝对是不寻常、值得注意的，而且有趣的是，它为全国范围内类似的起诉威胁铺平了道路，包括在芝加哥和纽约等北方城市。

sentences.en: And shortly after this Florida suit came down.
sentences.zh: 就在佛罗里达州这起诉讼提出后不久。

sentences.en: The American Federation of Teachers has told its 1.7 million members that if they choose to strike, the union will have their back.
sentences.zh: 美国教师联合会告诉其170万名成员，如果他们选择罢工，工会将支持他们。

sentences.en: The American Federation of Teachers, which is one of the two national unions,
sentences.zh: 美国教师联合会是两个全国性工会之一，

sentences.en: authorized any of their locals across the country to plan a strike in the event that safety precautions are not being met to reopen schools.
sentences.zh: 授权其全国各地的任何地方分会，在重开学校的安全预防措施未得到满足的情况下计划罢工。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So a national teachers union is saying a grounds for striking, which traditionally we've always thought of as, you know, wages, health care, those kinds of issues.
sentences.zh: 所以一个全国性的教师工会正在说罢工的理由，我们传统上一直认为罢工是因为工资、医疗保健等问题。

sentences.en: They're now saying you may decide to strike over unsafe school conditions in the middle of this pandemic.
sentences.zh: 他们现在说，你可能会决定在疫情期间因为不安全的学校环境而罢工。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This threat to strike is very powerful and pragmatic because once teachers threaten to strike over the safety measures and questions of funding,
sentences.zh: 这种罢工威胁非常有力且务实，因为一旦教师威胁要就安全措施和资金问题进行罢工，

sentences.en: it really puts pressure on the local school districts to give them a big seat at the table and just the core decision, which is,
sentences.zh: 这确实会给地方学区施加压力，让他们在核心决策中获得重要席位，即：

sentences.en: are we even going to try to have in-person school this fall?
sentences.zh: 我们今年秋天是否还要尝试进行面对面授课？

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道你需要订阅《纽约时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费探索《纽约时报》一个月，而无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在该应用程序中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以越过付费墙，看看时报订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，请立即下载时报应用程序，并获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So, Dana, as teachers are seeking a place at the table and threatening to strike if they don't feel like schools are safe,
sentences.zh: 那么，达娜，当教师们寻求一席之地，并威胁说如果他们觉得学校不安全就罢工时，

sentences.en: what exactly are they asking for in order to feel ready to return to the classroom?
sentences.zh: 他们到底要求什么才能感到准备好回到教室？

sentences.en: We're seeing a very broad range of demands from teachers, and it runs the spectrum from very specific and achievable requests to ones that are hugely ambitious,
sentences.zh: 我们看到教师们提出了非常广泛的要求，范围从非常具体且可实现的要求，到那些雄心勃勃、

sentences.en: time-consuming, expensive, or maybe even impossible to achieve while we're still experiencing any transmission of COVID-19.
sentences.zh: 耗时、昂贵，甚至在我们仍然经历新冠病毒传播时可能无法实现的要求。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: So, for example, in Orlando, when I spoke to teachers there in July, the requests were really quite reasonable.
sentences.zh: 例如，在奥兰多，当我在7月份与那里的教师交谈时，他们的要求确实非常合理。

sentences.en: They wanted face masks to be required.
sentences.zh: 他们要求必须佩戴口罩。

sentences.en: They wanted temperature checks in all school district buildings.
sentences.zh: 他们要求所有学区建筑内进行体温检测。

sentences.en: And then the American Federation of Teachers, the national union that authorized strikes, had a very specific set of demands that they were looking for nationally.
sentences.zh: 然后，授权罢工的全国性工会——美国教师联合会，提出了一套非常具体的全国性要求。

sentences.en: They wanted to see test positivity rates for the virus below 5 percent, transmission rates below 1 percent,
sentences.zh: 他们希望看到病毒检测阳性率低于5%，传播率低于1%，

sentences.en: effective contact tracing for the entire region, the school to require masks, update ventilation systems, and put in place procedures to maintain six feet of distance.
sentences.zh: 整个地区有效的接触者追踪，学校要求佩戴口罩，更新通风系统，并落实保持六英尺距离的程序。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So very much sort of in line with CDC guidelines for being as safe as possible.
sentences.zh: 所以这在很大程度上符合疾控中心关于尽可能安全的指导方针。

sentences.en: So the union is making demands of an entire community and level of infection and transmission and contact tracing beyond the school.
sentences.zh: 所以工会正在对整个社区以及学校以外的感染、传播水平和接触者追踪提出要求。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: They're expecting those things to work in the whole region before you sort of even get to the question of what sort of PPE is available to teachers, something like that.
sentences.zh: 他们期望在教师获得某种个人防护装备之前，这些事情能在整个地区发挥作用，诸如此类。

sentences.en: What about less practical requests from teachers?
sentences.zh: 那么老师们提出的那些不太切合实际的要求呢？

sentences.en: So there you see this big movement bubbling up on social media under the hashtag 14 days, no new cases.
sentences.zh: 你看，社交媒体上正掀起一场声势浩大的运动，标签是“14天零新增”。

sentences.en: And this is really quite a radical demand for schools not to reopen physically until there are no new cases in a region for 14 days.
sentences.zh: 这是一项相当激进的要求，即在某个地区连续14天没有新增病例之前，学校不应恢复线下授课。

sentences.en: Now, many nations have been able to reopen their schools safely without achieving that standard.
sentences.zh: 目前，许多国家在未达到这一标准的情况下，已经成功安全地重新开放了学校。

sentences.en: And when I've spoken to public health experts about this, what they say is, you know, 14 days, no new cases is not just a controlled pandemic.
sentences.zh: 当我与公共卫生专家谈论此事时，他们表示，“14天零新增”不仅仅意味着疫情得到了控制。

sentences.en: It's essentially the end of the pandemic in that region.
sentences.zh: 这基本上意味着该地区的疫情已经结束。

sentences.en: And it might require a vaccine to get to that standard, not just a vaccine that exists and works, but that has actually been deployed widely.
sentences.zh: 要达到这个标准可能需要疫苗，而且不仅是研发出有效的疫苗，还必须实现广泛接种。

sentences.en: When will that occur?
sentences.zh: 这何时才能实现呢？

sentences.en: Will that occur six months from now, 12 months from now, two years from now?
sentences.zh: 是六个月后，十二个月后，还是两年后？

sentences.en: We just don't know the answer to that.
sentences.zh: 我们根本不知道答案。

sentences.en: And those start to be very big numbers when you're thinking about children being out of school.
sentences.zh: 当你考虑到孩子们长期无法上学时，这些数字就开始变得非常惊人了。

sentences.en: I wonder what these demands from teachers look like to parents in this moment.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇，家长们现在是如何看待老师们提出的这些要求的。

sentences.en: I mean, I'm mindful that many parents want their kids to return to school for a variety of very understandable reasons.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我理解许多家长出于各种非常合理的理由，希望孩子能重返校园。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, I think the really hard thing is that there is no consensus or even strong majority opinion among parents.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，真正棘手的是，家长们之间并没有达成共识，甚至连强有力的多数意见都没有。

sentences.en: One recent national poll found about 60 percent of parents at this moment believe it's smarter to delay reopening physical schools
sentences.zh: 最近一项全国性民调显示，目前约有60%的家长认为，推迟恢复线下教学更为明智，

sentences.en: until the virus subsides somewhat and there are more safety measures in place.
sentences.zh: 直到病毒有所消退，并采取更多的安全措施。

sentences.en: But in some big cities where the virus has been relatively well controlled, like New York and Chicago,
sentences.zh: 但在一些病毒控制相对较好的大城市，比如纽约和芝加哥，

sentences.en: polls have found that a majority of families do have some willingness to send their kids back to school.
sentences.zh: 民调发现，大多数家庭确实愿意让孩子重返校园。

sentences.en: And to add another layer of complication,
sentences.zh: 更复杂的一点是，

sentences.en: it tends to be parents of color and low-income parents that are the most scared of the health threats to their children of congregating in school buildings.
sentences.zh: 往往是有色人种家长和低收入家长，最担心孩子在学校聚集会面临健康威胁。

sentences.en: But those families are also the most concerned about their kids falling back socially and academically because schools are closed.
sentences.zh: 但这些家庭也最担心学校关闭会导致孩子在社交和学业上落后。

sentences.en: So there is just no consensus among parents as to what they feel is safe.
sentences.zh: 所以，家长们对于什么是安全的，根本没有达成共识。

sentences.en: It would in some ways be easier if American parents all agreed with each other about what was right here.
sentences.zh: 如果美国家长们在什么是正确的问题上能达成一致，在某些方面会更容易处理。

sentences.en: And of course, in the absence of physically returning to schools, we're left with online learning.
sentences.zh: 当然，在无法重返校园的情况下，我们只能选择在线学习。

sentences.en: And we have covered on the show the problems with how teachers and school districts are approaching that.
sentences.zh: 我们在节目中也讨论过老师和学区在处理在线教学时存在的问题。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So in the spring, only a small segment of American school districts actually required teachers to teach live lessons over something like Zoom video.
sentences.zh: 在春季，只有一小部分美国学区要求老师通过Zoom视频等平台进行直播教学。

sentences.en: And here I think there is actually more risk of tension between parents and teachers
sentences.zh: 我认为，家长和老师之间产生矛盾的风险反而更大了，

sentences.en: because we're starting to see from polls what parents are asking for in a situation of continued remote learning.
sentences.zh: 因为我们从民调中开始看到，家长们在持续远程学习的情况下有何诉求。

sentences.en: They were not happy that in the spring, many of their kids did not see teachers live over video.
sentences.zh: 他们对春季时许多孩子没能通过视频看到老师直播授课感到不满。

sentences.en: Many teachers were interacting with their students primarily over email at sort of random times per day.
sentences.zh: 许多老师主要通过电子邮件在一天中随机的时间与学生互动。

sentences.en: And that's not what parents want.
sentences.zh: 而这并不是家长们想要的。

sentences.en: They want their students to log on at very specific times and be in something like an online class
sentences.zh: 他们希望学生能在特定的时间登录，参加类似在线课堂的活动，

sentences.en: where they would have small group breakout sessions and discussions and have the opportunity to ask the teacher questions and get individualized feedback.
sentences.zh: 在那里进行小组讨论，有机会向老师提问并获得个性化的反馈。

sentences.en: And teachers unions are still in some cases resisting some of these practices, including even showing their faces on live video.
sentences.zh: 而教师工会在某些情况下仍在抵制这些做法，甚至包括拒绝在直播视频中露脸。

sentences.en: And Dana, why would that be?
sentences.zh: 达娜，这是为什么呢？

sentences.en: I guess I'm confused.
sentences.zh: 我有点困惑。

sentences.en: If teachers are deeply reluctant to return to schools for very understandable reasons that you just outlined, and they don't feel school districts are meeting them halfway,
sentences.zh: 如果老师们出于你刚才提到的非常合理的理由，非常不情愿回到学校，而且他们觉得学区没有做出妥协，

sentences.en: why would they simultaneously be resisting a more enriched online remote teaching experience?
sentences.zh: 为什么他们同时又在抵制更丰富的在线远程教学体验呢？

sentences.en: Well, some of them make the argument that it's not fair to provide too much live instruction because students who don't have an adult to supervise their online learning at home,
sentences.zh: 嗯，有些人认为，提供过多的直播教学是不公平的，因为那些家里没有大人监督在线学习的学生，

sentences.en: say at exactly 10 a.m., might just miss out on the live lesson.
sentences.zh: 比如在上午10点整，可能会错过直播课。

sentences.en: So they think that that mode of education is not effective.
sentences.zh: 所以他们认为这种教育模式并不有效。

sentences.en: But I've also heard some arguments much simpler than that, that they don't want their homes to be shown.
sentences.zh: 但我还听到过一些更简单的理由，比如他们不想让自己的家被展示出来。

sentences.en: They're not comfortable in that medium, and they believe it's a violation of their own privacy to be shown from home in that way.
sentences.zh: 他们对这种媒介感到不自在，并认为以这种方式从家中展示自己侵犯了他们的隐私。

sentences.en: So it's a range of different arguments there.
sentences.zh: 所以，这背后有一系列不同的论点。

sentences.en: That would seem to raise a real crisis.
sentences.zh: 这似乎引发了一场真正的危机。

sentences.en: I mean, teachers both not wanting to be in classrooms, but also not wanting to teach online the way parents want them to.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，老师们既不想去教室，也不想按照家长希望的方式进行在线教学。

sentences.en: Well, this has been the sort of crux of these very tense latest negotiations across the country between teachers and school district leaders.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这正是全国各地教师与学区领导之间最新一轮紧张谈判的核心所在。

sentences.en: Dana, I know a bunch of school districts around the country have actually started classes in schools.
sentences.zh: 达娜，我知道全国有很多学区已经开始在校上课了。

sentences.en: And I wonder how that has played out.
sentences.zh: 我想知道情况如何？

sentences.en: Well, there have been some horror stories, unfortunately.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，确实发生了一些可怕的事情。

sentences.en: In Georgia, this photo of a crowded hallway, no mask in sight, from North Paulding High School went viral after the school opened for in-person learning on August 3rd.
sentences.zh: 在佐治亚州，北保尔丁高中的一张照片在网上疯传，照片显示走廊里挤满了人，没戴口罩，这是该校8月3日恢复线下教学后拍摄的。

sentences.en: You know, for one of the first school districts to reopen, which was in Georgia, hundreds of staff were told to stay home because of potential exposure to the virus.
sentences.zh: 你知道，作为首批重新开放的学区之一，佐治亚州的那个学区有数百名员工因为可能接触过病毒而被要求居家隔离。

sentences.en: Today, the school remained closed a week after that reopening.
sentences.zh: 今天，该校在重新开放一周后仍然处于关闭状态。

sentences.en: In Indiana.
sentences.zh: 在印第安纳州，

sentences.en: One student at Greenfield Central Junior High tested positive on the very first day of school.
sentences.zh: 格林菲尔德中央初中的一名学生在开学第一天就检测呈阳性。

sentences.en: Right away, this junior high school was having, you know, to call teachers and call students' families and ask them to stay home for two weeks.
sentences.zh: 这所初中立刻不得不打电话给老师和学生的家人，要求他们居家隔离两周。

sentences.en: Students at Elwood Junior Senior High now have to go remote after staff members there tested positive for COVID-19.
sentences.zh: 埃尔伍德初高中的学生现在不得不转为远程学习，因为那里的工作人员新冠病毒检测呈阳性。

sentences.en: Now, that's extremely alarming, but I want to say that nobody who's a public health or education expert
sentences.zh: 这确实非常令人担忧，但我必须说，没有任何公共卫生或教育专家

sentences.en: believes that we're going to reopen schools without students and teachers showing up from time to time positive for COVID-19.
sentences.zh: 认为我们能在不出现学生和老师偶尔检测出新冠阳性的情况下重新开放学校。

sentences.en: That's not a realistic expectation.
sentences.zh: 那是不切实际的期望。

sentences.en: But what we do need is procedures in place to deal with that when it happens.
sentences.zh: 但我们确实需要制定相应的程序来应对这种情况。

sentences.en: I mean, it needs to be clear who is getting told to stay home for two weeks, and is there access to testing for anyone who came in contact with that positive individual.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，必须明确谁需要居家隔离两周，以及与阳性病例有过接触的人是否能获得检测。

sentences.en: So, in many ways, I think these anecdotes that we're hearing of kind of first-day-back crises in towns and cities that are trying to reopen physically do show that, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以，在很多方面，我认为我们听到的这些关于城镇学校重新开放第一天就陷入危机的轶事确实表明，

sentences.en: many of the concerns that teachers have brought to the table here are quite legitimate.
sentences.zh: 老师们提出的许多担忧是非常合理的。

sentences.en: So, those are a small number of districts that have already reopened.
sentences.zh: 所以，这些只是已经重新开放的一小部分学区。

sentences.en: But, of course, many of the nation's largest school districts,
sentences.zh: 但当然，全国许多最大的学区，

sentences.en: Chicago, Los Angeles, Washington, D.C., among others, are now firmly saying that they will not physically reopen schools, at least initially.
sentences.zh: 比如芝加哥、洛杉矶、华盛顿特区等，现在都坚定地表示，至少在初期，他们不会恢复线下教学。

sentences.en: And that represents millions of students.
sentences.zh: 这涉及数百万名学生。

sentences.en: So, do teachers' unions and teachers see that as a kind of victory?
sentences.zh: 那么，教师工会和老师们是否将其视为一种胜利？

sentences.en: They do see it as a victory, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 他们确实将其视为一场胜利，绝对是。

sentences.en: They believe that it's not only what's necessary to protect their health, but to prevent schools emerging as potential hotspots for spreading COVID-19.
sentences.zh: 他们认为，这不仅是保护自身健康所必需的，也是防止学校成为新冠病毒潜在传播热点的必要举措。

sentences.en: But I think within that victory, there's also a real tragedy for American children, and actually for our country, because to be in a place where the needs of public health
sentences.zh: 但我认为，在这场胜利背后，对美国儿童乃至我们的国家来说，也是一场真正的悲剧，因为公共卫生的需求

sentences.en: and safety are really juxtaposed against our ability to fully educate our kids is to be in a place that very few other developed nations are in right now.
sentences.zh: 与我们全面教育孩子的能力发生冲突，这在目前其他发达国家中是很少见的。

sentences.en: And it is because of our failure to control the pandemic itself.
sentences.zh: 而这正是因为我们未能控制住疫情本身。

sentences.en: We are looking at the real likelihood that millions or tens of millions of children do not attend school for an entire year, a full year of no school.
sentences.zh: 我们正面临着数百万甚至数千万儿童整整一年无法上学的现实可能性，整整一年没有学校生活。

sentences.en: And we just know that it's going to lead to big probleMs.
sentences.zh: 我们知道这会导致严重的问题。

sentences.en: It's going to make kids less likely to learn to read.
sentences.zh: 这会让孩子们学习阅读的可能性降低。

sentences.en: It's going to probably lead to higher high school dropout rates.
sentences.zh: 这可能会导致更高的辍学率。

sentences.en: It's going to lead to students who don't have enough to eat because school is where they are fed and to students that don't have access to the mental health counseling
sentences.zh: 这会导致学生们因为学校是他们获得食物的地方而吃不饱饭，也会导致学生们无法获得心理健康咨询，

sentences.en: and the special education services that they get at schools.
sentences.zh: 以及他们在学校里能得到的特殊教育服务。

sentences.en: So the fact that we're having to choose between everything crucial that the physical school provides and public health, it's stunning.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们竟然不得不在学校提供的所有关键服务和公共卫生之间做出选择，这太令人震惊了。

sentences.en: It's stunning to me as a 15-year veteran on the education beat and just also as a parent.
sentences.zh: 作为一名在教育领域工作了15年的老兵，同时也是一位家长，这让我感到震惊。

sentences.en: You know, my daughter is going to come through this pandemic just fine.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我的女儿会安然度过这场疫情。

sentences.en: You know, she has access to great child care and we have a lot of resources in our home and family to bring her through this.
sentences.zh: 她有很好的托儿服务，我们的家庭也有足够的资源来帮助她度过难关。

sentences.en: But still, it's really sad for our family that she's missing the preschool experience that we really wanted her to have.
sentences.zh: 但即便如此，她错过了我们非常希望她拥有的学前教育体验，这对我们家来说真的很遗憾。

sentences.en: Like, it's been months since she was with teachers and socializing with a group of students and she's started even to become more timid around other kids.
sentences.zh: 比如，她已经好几个月没有和老师在一起，也没有和一群学生进行社交了，她甚至开始在其他孩子面前变得更加胆怯。

sentences.en: We've noticed when we do take those walks out to the playground.
sentences.zh: 当我们带她去操场散步时，我们注意到了这一点。

sentences.en: And, you know, it's sad for our family and it's just a tiny microcosm of how sad it is for our country.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这对我们家来说很悲伤，这只是我们国家悲伤处境的一个微小缩影。

sentences.en: Dana, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 达娜，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you so much, Michael.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Starting this week, several Florida school districts began holding in-person classes even as the lawsuit filed by the state's teachers union moves ahead.
sentences.zh: 从本周开始，佛罗里达州的几个学区开始进行线下授课，尽管州教师工会提起的诉讼仍在进行中。

sentences.en: A court hearing in that case is scheduled for later today.
sentences.zh: 该案的法庭听证会定于今天晚些时候举行。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, in New York City on Wednesday, the influential unions representing principals and teachers called on the city to delay starting in-person instruction by several weeks.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，周三在纽约市，代表校长和教师的有影响力的工会呼吁市政府将线下教学的开始时间推迟几周。

sentences.en: In a statement, one of the union's leaders said that the city had failed to address teachers' safety concerns
sentences.zh: 工会领导人在一份声明中表示，市政府未能解决教师的安全担忧，

sentences.en: and had failed to give them enough time to implement complicated safety protocols.
sentences.zh: 也没有给他们足够的时间来实施复杂的安全规程。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: Good afternoon, everyone.
sentences.zh: 大家下午好。

sentences.en: To me and to Kamal, this is an exciting day.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，对卡玛拉来说，这是一个激动人心的日子。

sentences.en: It's a great day for our campaign.
sentences.zh: 这对我们的竞选活动来说是伟大的一天。

sentences.en: It's a great day for America, in my view.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，这对美国来说也是伟大的一天。

sentences.en: During their first joint appearance as a ticket on Wednesday,
sentences.zh: 周三，作为竞选搭档首次共同亮相时，

sentences.en: Joe Biden praised Kamala Harris for her record as the attorney general of California and as a United States senator, calling her an unapologetic advocate for justice.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登称赞了卡玛拉·哈里斯担任加州总检察长和美国参议员期间的政绩，称她是正义的坚定捍卫者。

sentences.en: Thank you, Joe.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，乔。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you, Joe.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，乔。

sentences.en: As I said, Joe, when you called me, I am incredibly honored by this responsibility, and I'm ready to get to work.
sentences.zh: 正如我所说，乔，当你打电话给我时，我感到无比荣幸，我准备好开始工作了。

sentences.en: I am ready to get to work.
sentences.zh: 我准备好开始工作了。

sentences.en: In her remarks, Harris immediately delivered a stinging indictment of President Trump as a self-absorbed leader who has repeatedly failed America, above all, during the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 在讲话中，哈里斯立即对特朗普总统进行了严厉抨击，称他是一位以自我为中心的领导人，多次辜负了美国，尤其是在疫情期间。

sentences.en: America is crying out for leadership.
sentences.zh: 美国迫切需要领导力。

sentences.en: Yet we have a president who cares more about himself than the people who elected him.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们有一位比起选民更关心自己的总统。

sentences.en: A president who is making every challenge we face even more difficult to solve.
sentences.zh: 一位让我们要面对的每一个挑战都变得更加难以解决的总统。

sentences.en: But here's the good news.
sentences.zh: 但好消息是，

sentences.en: We don't have to accept the failed government of Donald Trump and Mike Pence.
sentences.zh: 我们不必接受唐纳德·特朗普和迈克·彭斯失败的政府。

sentences.en: In just 83 days, we have a chance to choose a better future.
sentences.zh: 在短短83天内，我们有机会选择一个更美好的未来。

sentences.en: And I hope that the Russians have actually definitively proven that the vaccine is safe and effective.
sentences.zh: 我希望俄罗斯人真的已经确凿地证明了该疫苗是安全有效的。

sentences.en: I seriously doubt that they've done that.
sentences.zh: 我严重怀疑他们是否做到了这一点。

sentences.en: The Trump administration's top advisor on the pandemic, Dr. Anthony Fauci, expressed deep doubts about Russia's rushed plan to distribute a vaccine for the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府的顶级疫情顾问安东尼·福奇博士对俄罗斯仓促分发新冠疫苗的计划表示了深深的怀疑。

sentences.en: The vaccine, called Sputnik V, was approved by Russia's government without evidence that the largest and most important phase of human testing had ever occurred.
sentences.zh: 这种名为“卫星五号”的疫苗在未经证实已完成最大规模、最重要的临床试验阶段的情况下，就获得了俄罗斯政府的批准。

sentences.en: So if we wanted to take the chance of hurting a lot of people or giving them something that doesn't work, we could start doing this, you know, next week if we wanted to.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果我们想冒险伤害很多人，或者给他们一些无效的东西，我们下周就可以开始这样做，如果我们想的话。

sentences.en: But that's not the way it works.
sentences.zh: 但事情不是这样运作的。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是今天的《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》节目，我们将为假期招待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 敬请收听，获取让客人感到宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是说他们是不是睡着了就人事不省。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线环境？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 请在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何平台上收听《Wirecutter秀》。
